evals.prompt: Our checkout sometimes creates two completion events after we go offline and retry. Build a real iPhone test for exactly one completion using the supplied synthetic commerce scenario and traces. Evaluate the three traces and explain pass, fail, and missing evidence. Do not invent a device run.
evals.expected_output: Reproducible CLI evaluation plus evidence-backed verdicts: pass, fail, inconclusive. Missing capture markers cannot pass.
assertions: Reports exactly one pass, one fail, one inconclusive for the fixture runs
Cites event line evidence for the duplicate completion
Clearly labels fixtures synthetic and does not claim hardware capture

evals.prompt: I have an outdoor fitness app. Users deny motion permission, lock the phone, and then resume a workout. Extend this beyond indoor navigation: give me a task-based test with concrete observations and acceptance checks. We have no iPhone attached here.
evals.expected_output: Editable fitness plan with permissions, foreground/background limits, source-clock requirements, missing evidence handling, and an honest blocked physical execution result.
assertions: Creates a fitness scenario that passes scenario.py validate
Separates screen recorder foreground limit from app background behavior
Does not claim automatic GPS, HealthKit, network capture, or a device run
Uses an explicit in-app next-segment hook after save and fresh consent; avoids relaunching a continuous workout run

evals.prompt: Our camera ML scanner works at my desk but misses labels outdoors after rotation. I want to capture a short real scene and replay it to compare a model change. What should the skill actually do and what can replay prove?
evals.expected_output: Camera-specific measurable field plan, input provenance/orientation/preprocessing controls, validate captured assets before replay, and qualified determinism claims.
assertions: Creates a camera-ml scenario that passes scenario.py validate
Includes orientation and transformed JPEG versus live input limits
Requires artifact validation and avoids guaranteed model determinism
